fato_historico: 1965: Joseph-Désiré Mobutu seizes power in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and becomes President; he rules the country (which he renames Zaire in 1971) for over 30 years, until being overthrown by rebels in 1997.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a pivotal shift in your personal narrative, much like when a leader claims their throne to reshape the future. Consider how you lead your own life with grace and diplomacy. It is a good time to reflect on your long-term influence and how you build your personal empire of beauty and true justice.
frase_do_dia: Your kindness is the most powerful tool you possess to lead your own heart.
significado_numero: Represents the structural harmony and balance you strive for today.
conselho: Stand firm in your decisions while keeping your heart open to gentle wisdom.
